preservation: All eight new one-pass generated PNGs copied byte-for-byte. Two previously generated transparent character PNGs reused byte-for-byte. No cropping, resampling, repair or post-processing.
notes: Requested target resolutions were 1536 × 2048 portrait and 2048 × 1536 landscape; built-in outputs returned 1086 × 1448 and 1448 × 1086 respectively. Exact 3:4 / 4:3 canvas ratios are retained.
Both transparent character assets retain native 1254 × 1254 resolution and alpha 0 at all four corners.
Combined variants use only the transparent character reference; backgrounds were described verbally to avoid importing narrow phone canvas proportions.
Character scale and faint pattern are imagegen approximations; all outputs preserved as returned.
